name: us-federal-awards-scraper
title: USAspending Scraper — US Federal Contracts & Grants
description: Every US federal contract, IDV, grant, loan and direct payment from the official USAspending.gov awards API — plus the sub-contracts and sub-grants filed under them, joined to the prime award. 53 typed fields incl. recipient UEI/address, NAICS/PSC, CFDA. Filter by agency, keyword, state, date.
